shortDescription: Virgin Mobile UAE is a fully digital mobile brand operating as a business unit within Emirates Integrated Telecommunications Company (EITC).
whatTheyDo: Virgin Mobile UAE delivers an app-based mobile telecommunications service enabling consumers to customize plans, select numbers, and manage mobile services digitally without visiting physical stores. It utilizes the telecommunications network and infrastructure of parent company EITC (du).
address: Floor No. 4A, Building 5, Dubai Design District (d3), Dubai, United Arab Emirates

notes: Virgin Mobile UAE operates as a digital business unit within Emirates Integrated Telecommunications Company PJSC (EITC), the company behind du. The previous directory entry listed its area as Downtown, but the headquarters is located in Dubai Design District (Building 5).

shortDescription: Visa operates its regional headquarters for Central and Eastern Europe, Middle East, and Africa (CEMEA) and an Innovation Center in Dubai.
whatTheyDo: Visa provides digital payment processing, electronic funds transfers, fintech infrastructure, and consulting services supporting operations across nearly 90 countries from Dubai. Its regional office houses consulting directors, sales engineering, communications, and digital commerce teams.
address: Visa CEMEA Headquarters, Al Falak Street, Dubai Media City, Dubai, UAE

shortDescription: Wasl Asset Management Group is a major Dubai government real estate management and urban development organisation.
whatTheyDo: Established in 2008 by the Dubai Real Estate Corporation (DREC), Wasl manages extensive property portfolios spanning residential, commercial, and industrial developments across Dubai. It oversees landmark projects such as the Food Tech Valley and 1 Billion Meals Endowment Tower, alongside hospitality and leisure operations.
address: Wasl Experience Center, Al Safa 2, Sheikh Zayed Road, Dubai, UAE

shortDescription: Zahrawi Medical (Zahrawi Group) is a leading distributor of medical equipment, surgical robotics, and diagnostic solutions in the UAE and GCC.
whatTheyDo: Zahrawi Group supplies medical equipment, clinical diagnostic tools, and surgical technologies to healthcare providers, hospitals, and laboratories across the UAE. It partners with international medical manufacturers such as Zimmer Biomet and Medtronic to distribute specialised healthcare equipment and provide biomedical support services.
address: 1st Floor, Ford Middle East & Africa Building, Al Wasl Office Complex, Sheikh Zayed Road, Downtown, Dubai, United Arab Emirates

shortDescription: Zomato UAE operates a restaurant discovery, menu guide, and dining-out ratings service in the UAE.
whatTheyDo: Zomato provides an online platform where users in Dubai and across the UAE can search restaurants, view menus, read reviews, and explore dining experiences. After selling its UAE food delivery operations to Delivery Hero (Talabat) in 2019 and ceasing food delivery ordering in November 2022, its UAE operations focus exclusively on restaurant search, dining out, and discovery.
address: 13th Floor, Burj Al Salam Tower, Trade Centre 1, Sheikh Zayed Road, Dubai, UAE
